name: Premal Shah
current_role: Co-founder and former president of Kiva
summary: Premal Shah joined PayPal in 2000 as one of its first 50 employees and worked there as a product manager before leaving to help build Kiva, the microlending nonprofit, which he led as president. He appeared in Fortune's 2007 PayPal Mafia photo.
